render_subgraph_to_graphviz: render a subgraph.Graph into a graphviz pydot graph for visualization
convert_graphviz_to_png: convert a pydot graph or subgraph into PNG image bytes using the dot layout engine
open_graph_viewer: render an AgentFlow policy option to a PNG and open it in the default viewer
add_custom_renderer: register a custom rendering function for a specific AgentFlow policy node type
validate_state_machine_graph: validate that a subgraph.Graph is acyclic with proper entry nodes and connected edges
